properties.name: --noesis-secondary-text
properties.description: Secondary text: quieter than the body text, a step more contrast than Mantine's dimmed. Gray 7 in light, dark 1 in dark, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-rail-background
properties.description: The ground of the app's navigation, the top bar and the rail: a tint off the page. Gray 1 in light, dark 8 in dark, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-rail-border
properties.description: The line that rules the top bar and the rail off from the page, and outlines what is raised on the rail. Gray 2 in light, dark 5 in dark, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-rail-surface
properties.description: What is raised on the rail: the change's card and the item you are on. White in light, dark 7 in dark, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-brand-mark
properties.description: The Noesis mark's colour, from the brand book: navy #2B2D3C in light, cyan #7EE3E8 in dark, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-focus-ring
properties.description: The outline a control takes under the keyboard (`:focus-visible`), in the brand filled colour; each rule sets its own offset. from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-architecture-edge
properties.description: Lines and borders of the architecture diagram: its edges and adapter cards. Gray 6 / dark 2, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-card
properties.description: A card on any diagram, the exploration's and the architecture's. White / dark 6, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-card-border
properties.description: A diagram card's hairline. Gray 3 / dark 4, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-module
properties.description: A module's frame on a diagram: the exploration's container, the architecture's hexagon. Brand 0 at 40% / brand 7 at 6%, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-module-border
properties.description: A module frame's edge. Brand 2 / brand 5, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-block
properties.description: A building block's frame, or the architecture's domain core: a shade more than a module's. Brand 0 at 60% / dark 7 at 95%, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-block-border
properties.description: A building block frame's edge. Brand 2 / brand 6, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-diagram-selection
properties.description: What marks the selected element on a diagram, and what relates to it: brand 5, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-requirement-quote
properties.description: Background of a quoted need or rule statement in the requirements view. Gray 0 / dark 6, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.

properties.name: --noesis-requirement-gap
properties.description: Text and underline of a gap in the requirements view — a need no rule traces to. Red 8 / red 4, from `cssVariablesResolver` in `theme.ts`.
